steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ instead of creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Set the post-expiry surrogate-bid setting required by the case.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Restrict evaluation reopening as required by the case.
Navigate to the RFQ stage named by the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where Download Report is available.
Verify the control being explored is present before activating it.
Verify the expected report window opened.
Verify the report-selection control is present.
Verify Event Ref ID is offered.
Verify Event Terms and Conditions is offered.
Verify the window indicates the additional report fields.
Verify the download action is available while leaving it unpressed.
Verify the underlying page remains the RFQ Responses screen while the report window is open.
